已运行的 ComfyUI 会直接复用；退出时只关闭本次由 Pictide 启动的: Reuse ComfyUI if it is already running. On exit, stop only the process started by Pictide.
请在运行 Pictide 的电脑上通过本机地址配置。: Configure this using localhost on the computer running Pictide.
请先保存一个本机 ComfyUI 生图 API。: Save a local ComfyUI image API first.
输入安装目录，或留空后自动识别: Enter the installation folder, or leave blank to detect it
带空格的路径也占一行，无需引号。监听地址和端口跟随关联 API。: Keep paths with spaces on one line, without quotes. The linked API determines the listening address and port.
已保存，下次启动 Pictide 时生效。: Saved. Changes apply the next time Pictide starts.
下次启动 Pictide 时生效。: Changes apply the next time Pictide starts.
没有识别到可启动的 ComfyUI，请手动指定路径和 Python。: No runnable ComfyUI installation was detected. Specify its folder and Python interpreter.
请选择一个已保存的本机 ComfyUI 生图 API。: Select a saved local ComfyUI image API.
随应用启停需要不带路径的本机 HTTP ComfyUI 地址。: Startup management requires a local HTTP ComfyUI address without a URL path.
未找到 ComfyUI 的 main.py，请检查安装路径。: ComfyUI main.py was not found. Check the installation path.
未找到 ComfyUI 的 Python，请在高级配置中指定解释器。: ComfyUI Python was not found. Specify the interpreter in advanced settings.
ComfyUI 工作目录不存在。: The ComfyUI working directory does not exist.
ComfyUI 启停配置损坏，请重新保存。: ComfyUI startup settings are damaged. Save them again.
ComfyUI 随应用启停须为布尔值。: The ComfyUI startup option must be a boolean.
ComfyUI 路径或连接标识无效。: The ComfyUI path or connection ID is invalid.
ComfyUI 启动参数须为字符串数组，且总长度不超过 32768。: ComfyUI startup arguments must be a string array with at most 32768 characters.
ComfyUI 启停设置包含未知字段或为空。: ComfyUI startup settings are empty or contain unknown fields.
请自动识别并选择 ComfyUI 安装，或手动指定路径。: Detect and select a ComfyUI installation, or specify its path.
ComfyUI 识别请求包含未知字段。: The ComfyUI detection request contains unknown fields.
ComfyUI 启动超时，请查看 logs/comfyui.log。: ComfyUI startup timed out; see logs/comfyui.log
ComfyUI 未能启动，请查看 logs/comfyui.log。: ComfyUI could not start; see logs/comfyui.log
配置的端口未提供可识别的 ComfyUI 服务。: The configured port does not provide a recognizable ComfyUI service
配置的端口未返回 ComfyUI 系统信息。: The configured port does not return ComfyUI system information
